Name: (CR) Kisaa's Extra Floors Pack for PIF
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[i][center][size=3]﻿﻿Ever want more variety of rooms for your farmhouse? Or is your modded farmhouse too small for your decorating needs? With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]﻿﻿, I bring you this mini pack of versatile tiny rooms!

[/size](Furnishings STILL not included!)[/center][/i]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]2 different extra floors for all your decorating/cluttering needs![/b]
[*][b]Upgradeable: [/b]These floors expand alongside farmhouse upgrades.
[*]The rooms are empty, so you can furnish them however you like!
[*]You can add a PIF door into these floors, so you can expand them [i]even more.[/i]
[*]Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28043]my collection of miscellaneous empty, tiny rooms![/url]﻿
[/list][size=3]
[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Extra Floor 1: [/b]Starts with 1 big room and 1 bathroom space. Upgrades add a total of 2 extra rooms.
[*][b]Extra Floor 2: [/b]Starts with 1 big room. Upgrades add a total of 1 bathroom space and 1 extra room.
[*][b]Fridge functionality [/b]is available in all items.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with recolor mods: Vibrant Pastoral, Earthy, Starblue, Eemie, etc.

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].
[*]Unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Extra Floors Pack for PIF" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me.
[/list]
[size=3]As usual please report any bugs here on Nexus, or you can reach out to me (crystalinerose) in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Modding Discord[/url]﻿ for a faster response.[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to DeLiXxN for creating PIF and making this mod possible, and the patient folks in the modding channels for helping me during the creation of this mod!

[b][size=3][i]Mods used in screenshots:﻿
[/i][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19186]Vanilla Furniture Tweaks﻿[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26068]Cellar Nook[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20268]Guxelbit's Furniture[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20384]Chest Deco[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PCs Rattan Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20013]Cozy Chocolate Walls & Floors[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20011]Cozy Chocolate Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24031]Combination Table[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4302]Lumisteria Custom Set of Furniture﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17031]Too Many Swatches﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[/list][/b]
